name: Suretap
feature_notes: Streetwise 1.1.0 fills a tapped address and keeps its map point with the request. Local lookup covers Richmond, Williamsburg and surrounding counties. Each enabled contractor uses the same component and public data.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.
